profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
Experienced, hands on technology professional with a vast breadth of experience in backend systems and solutions. Areas of expertise include microservice architecture, software development, streamlining engineering processes, automation, database design, and media streaming systems.

I have worked as a technical lead for a user profile system that managed user data securely and ethically, created/architected scalable backend and fullstack systems to meet consumer needs, migrated entire backends during a company split, resulting in 0 down time.

Current interests: Golang, Google Cloud Provider, Mongodb, Nodejs, Serverless Architectures, Kubernetes

Current Stack: GCP, AWS, Golang, Nodejs, Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develops, Maintains, Architects, Supports, Troubleshoots, and Manages a plethora of Web API’s that support a wide array of OTT Video Streaming Apps and Technologies in a scrum environment. Works with multiple developers from around the world along with Product / Project Managers to deliver business needs.

Highlighted Accomplishments:
   - Architected, Developed, and Replaced a legacy Profile system
      --- Contains 16+ mil users
   - Architected, Developed, and Replaced a legacy System to create and store user data
   - Integrated a machine learning recommendations engine powered by ActionML.
   - Integrated with Sales Force Marketing Cloud to send out automated Email Campaigns
   - Created an ETL job to export and transform Data from Dynamodb to S3, ultimately to redshift
   - Architected and created a POC using Kinesis Data streams
   - Managed various AWS Architectures / Solutions
      --- Dynamodb
      --- Elasticsearch
      --- Memcached
      --- Elasticbeanstalk
      --- ECS
      --- Cognito
      --- API Gateway
      --- IAM
      --- S3
      --- EC2
   - Implemented a process for Software Development that entailed planning, QA, Deployment, etc.
   - On boarded and trained multiple Developers
   - Worked on a team with 5 developers
   - Worked with external developers for integrations

Technologies:
- Elasticsearch
- Nodejs
- Docker
- AWS
- Codeship (CI/CD)

positions.title: Associate Technical Manager
positions.description:
Member and Student to a team of experienced and talented professionals at FOX NEOD. Assisted and provided technical insight and coverage over a wide array of OTT App Development. 

Platforms Include IOS, Android, Roku, Xbox One, Xbox 360, Samsung Smart TV, Android TV, Web player, and tvOS. 

Prominent Areas of Exposure:

-- Worked on developing Internal Applications
-- Wrote, ran, and maintained Migration scripts
-- Reviewed Code provided by developers for documentation purposes
-- Managed, Reported, Troubleshooted, Solved, and Closed various bug tickets
-- Compiled, Provisioned, and uploaded tvOS builds into itunes connect
-- Distributed Internal Staging, QA, and Development Builds with Xcode and Testflight
-- Worked closely with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Github

Other Duties

- Web Player Troubleshooting / some Development
- Coordination with various Vendors
- New Relic Mobile Monitoring

Additional Experience:

- PHP laravel framework
- Okta Identity management
- Adobe Pass
- Vagrant Box
- MPX
- XSLT
- HLS Video Streaming
